The app's Load Data wizard configuration

Source: R/wizard-config.R
cd_wizard_config.Rd

Returns what an app has set for its own part of the Load Data wizard. The wizard is the same for every indicator group except for two things, which an app describes once with options(cd2030.wizard = list(...)) before the wizard is used: the fields of the National Rates step and which reference-data upload zones the Upload Data step shows. The indicator group is not part of this configuration (see cd_wizard_indicator_group()).

Usage

cd_wizard_config()

Value

The value of getOption("cd2030.wizard"), a list, with reference_uploads filled in with its default when the app did not set it. The function stops with an error when the option, or its national_rates_groups element, is not set.

Details

An app sets the option like this:

options(cd2030.wizard = list(
  national_rates_groups = list(cd_wizard_field_group(...), ...),
  reference_uploads     = c("un_estimates", "wuenic_estimates", "un_mortality_estimates")
))

  • national_rates_groups (required): the groups of fields of the National Rates step, in display order. Each element is made with cd_wizard_field_group(), and each field in it with cd_wizard_survey_field() (a survey coverage estimate, in percent) or cd_wizard_rate_field() (a national rate, as a proportion). The wizard takes from these the inputs it shows, what it saves to and reads back from the dataset, and which values the step needs before it counts as complete: every field listed is required.

  • reference_uploads (optional): which reference-data zones the Upload Data step shows, any of "un_estimates", "wuenic_estimates" and "un_mortality_estimates". The default is all three.

Examples

old <- options(cd2030.wizard = list(
  national_rates_groups = list(
    cd_wizard_field_group("title_upload_group_maternal", "sub_upload_group_maternal",
      cd_wizard_survey_field("anc4_prop", "anc4", "title_upload_anc4_survey"),
      cd_wizard_national_rate_fields()
    )
  ),
  reference_uploads = c("un_estimates", "wuenic_estimates")
))

cfg <- cd_wizard_config()
cfg$reference_uploads
#> [1] "un_estimates"     "wuenic_estimates"
length(cfg$national_rates_groups[[1]]$fields)
#> [1] 6

options(old)
